create_interpreter_from_logical_form: create an Interpreter instance from a speaker name, logical form memory ID, and agent memory object
step_interpreter_with_agent: step the Interpreter with an agent to interpret a HUMAN_GIVE_COMMAND logical form and dispatch tasks
handle_move_action: handle a MOVE action by interpreting location references and creating a Move task with target position
handle_undo_action: handle an UNDO action by finding the last finished task and prompting the user to confirm undoing it
interpret_event_recursively: recursively interpret an EVENT logical form sub-tree into task generators or a ControlBlock with loop conditions
